periods.description: Major noble power bloc of the New Kingdom. In vol-21 the Langris house and Duke Dist are central because Celistia becomes one of Lux's queens and Dist manages internal affairs.
periods.history: Retains major influence after the old empire and through New Kingdom reconstruction.
periods.goals: Stabilize noble governance, support the new king, preserve territory and social order.
periods.structure: Great noble houses with individual lords; Dist Langris is the most visible representative in this volume.
